## A plot

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  labs(x = "Weight", y = "MPG", colour = "Cylinders") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```
